name: Microsoft 365
description: Enterprise productivity suite — Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive
notes: Group-wide deployment, 2050+ users across all four entities
classification_justification: Mail, files and meetings for the whole group. A long outage stops sales, purchasing and customer service within hours.

name: Exchange Online
description: Cloud email and calendaring for all entities
notes: Part of Microsoft 365 suite
classification_justification: Orders from distributors and suppliers still arrive by email. Restored right after identity.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Unified communications, chat and video conferencing
notes: Replaced Skype for Business — primary internal comms
classification_justification: Main internal channel and the crisis room during an incident. Calls can fall back to mobile phones for a few hours.

name: SharePoint Online
description: Intranet, document management and team collaboration
notes: Hosts Le Wiki du Fromage (internal knowledge base)

name: OneDrive for Business
description: Personal cloud file storage and sync
notes: Part of Microsoft 365 suite

name: Zoom Workplace
description: Video conferencing for external meetings and webinars
notes: Complement to Teams for customer-facing calls

name: Slack
description: Team messaging and channels
notes: Being decommissioned — migrating all channels to Teams

name: SAP S/4HANA
description: Enterprise resource planning — finance, procurement, production planning
notes: Core ERP for HQ — migration to latest version planned (SAP Cheddar)
classification_justification: Finance, purchasing and production planning for the French entity. Production orders stop after half a day without it.

name: SAP BW/4HANA
description: Business intelligence and analytical reporting on SAP data
notes: Feeds Power BI dashboards for executive reporting

name: SAP Concur
description: Travel and expense management
notes: Used by all employees for T&E claims

name: Sage X3
description: Accounting and financial management for NL and IT subsidiaries
notes: Kaasmeester and Formaggio Supremo — under review for SAP consolidation
classification_justification: Accounting for Kaasmeester and Formaggio Supremo. Month-end closing and supplier payments stop without it.

name: Coupa Procurement
description: Cloud procurement and spend management
notes: Procure-to-pay for indirect spend
classification_justification: Indirect purchasing. Urgent orders can be placed directly with suppliers for a few days.

name: QuickBooks Online
description: Cloud accounting for US distribution entity
notes: Fromage & Co Inc. only — basic GL + AP/AR
classification_justification: Basic ledger for the US entity only. Cyber rated low because the scope is small. To review: it holds payroll and bank data.

name: Salesforce Sales Cloud
description: CRM for B2B cheese distribution across Europe
notes: 350+ active users across European sales teams
classification_justification: Customer accounts, pricing and the order pipeline for European sales. Sales can work from SAP for a day.

name: Salesforce Service Cloud
description: Customer support and case management
notes: 60 agents handling B2B and B2C support

name: HubSpot Marketing Hub
description: Inbound marketing, email campaigns and lead generation
notes: Integrated with Salesforce for lead handoff

name: Workday HCM
description: Human capital management, payroll and talent
notes: Live for FR — NL, IT, US rollout in progress
classification_justification: HR records and French payroll. Payroll can slip a day. Leavers must still be disabled in Okta on time.

name: Cornerstone OnDemand
description: Learning management and talent development
notes: Being replaced by Workday Learning module

name: ServiceNow ITSM
description: IT service management — incidents, changes, requests
notes: Central ITSM for all entities — 15 IT agents
classification_justification: The IT team logs and coordinates the recovery here. Needed early, before business applications return.

name: Okta Workforce Identity
description: Identity and access management, SSO and MFA
notes: Central IdP for all SaaS apps — 2050+ users
classification_justification: Single sign-on and MFA for every SaaS application. Nobody can log in while it is down, so it is restored first.

name: Sophos Intercept X
description: Endpoint protection, EDR and threat response
notes: 2050+ endpoints protected across all sites
classification_justification: Endpoint protection for 2050 devices. Laptops are not reconnected after an incident until it is back.

name: Fortinet FortiGate
description: Next-gen firewall and network security
notes: Deployed at all 6 sites — HA pairs at Paris DC
classification_justification: Firewalls at every site. All network traffic depends on them. The configuration is backed up daily.

name: Tenable.io
description: Cloud-based vulnerability scanning and assessment
notes: Quarterly external + continuous internal scanning

name: Datadog
description: Infrastructure monitoring, APM and log management
notes: Monitors all production systems, APIs and IoT infra
classification_justification: Monitoring and alerts for production systems and the caves. Restored early to confirm that the other systems are healthy.

name: PagerDuty
description: Incident alerting and on-call management
notes: On-call rotation for IT ops team — integrated with Datadog

name: PRTG Network Monitor
description: On-premise network and bandwidth monitoring
notes: Monitors WAN links, switches and UPS across all sites

name: VMware vSphere
description: Server virtualization platform
notes: Runs all on-premise VMs — 4 ESXi hosts at Paris, 1 each at Gouda/Parma
classification_justification: Hosts every on-premise server, SAP included. Nothing on site restarts without it. The last full failover test is more than a year old and must be repeated.

name: Veeam Backup & Replication
description: Enterprise backup and disaster recovery
notes: Backs up all VMs and critical databases — RPO 4h / RTO 8h
classification_justification: Holds the backups used to restore every other system. A compromise would leave nothing to recover from.

name: GitHub Enterprise
description: Source code management and CI/CD
notes: 35 developers — all custom apps (La Boutique, B2B Portal, etc.)
classification_justification: Source code of all custom applications. A leak or tampering would affect the portals, so cyber is high. Developers can wait a few days.

name: Jira Software
description: Agile project management and issue tracking
notes: IT and product teams — 45 active users

name: Confluence
description: Knowledge base and documentation platform
notes: IT runbooks, architecture decisions and project docs

name: Figma
description: Collaborative UI/UX design tool
notes: Used for La Boutique and B2B Portal design

name: SonarQube
description: Static code analysis and quality gates
notes: Integrated in GitHub CI/CD — scans all custom code

name: CaveGuard IoT
description: Real-time monitoring of cheese aging caves — temperature, humidity, pH
notes: Pilot in 2 caves at Paris site — full rollout pending

name: FroMag
description: Cheese aging management — batch tracking, turning schedules, maturation curves
notes: Niche vendor — viability under review, may consolidate into SAP

name: CheeseTrack
description: Cold chain traceability — production to delivery with IoT integration
notes: Mandatory for AOP/DOP certification and EU compliance

name: QualityLab LIMS
description: Laboratory information management for cheese quality testing
notes: In-house system — tracks all quality tests and certifications

name: Power BI
description: Business intelligence dashboards and self-service analytics
notes: Connected to SAP BW, Salesforce and CheeseTrack
classification_justification: Management dashboards. Reports can wait until source systems are back.

name: Snowflake
description: Cloud data platform for advanced analytics
notes: Project Fondue pilot — cross-entity data warehouse

name: Talend Data Integration
description: ETL and data integration platform
notes: SAP-to-Salesforce sync, data feeds to Power BI
classification_justification: Carries the SAP to Salesforce sync and the reporting feeds. Restored with the systems it connects.

name: La Boutique du Fromage
description: Direct-to-consumer e-commerce for cheese subscription boxes
notes: Fromage-as-a-Service project — React + Node.js on AWS

name: Fromage B2B Portal
description: Self-service ordering portal for wholesale distributors
notes: 500+ active distributor accounts across Europe
classification_justification: Ordering portal for 500 distributors. Exposed to the internet and holds customer contacts. Orders can go by email for a day.

name: Cave Monitoring Dashboard
description: Real-time cave conditions visualization (Grafana-based)
notes: Custom Grafana dashboards over CaveGuard data

name: DocuSign
description: Electronic signatures for contracts, procurement and HR
notes: 80 envelopes/month — procurement, legal and HR
classification_justification: Electronic signature of contracts and HR documents. Paper signature is the fallback.

name: Adobe Acrobat Pro
description: PDF creation, editing and digital signatures
notes: 200 licenses across all entities

name: Cisco Meraki
description: Cloud-managed network switches and wireless access points
notes: Office networks at Gouda, Parma and New York sites

name: Lotus Notes
description: Legacy email and collaboration platform
notes: Fully decommissioned — migrated to Exchange/SharePoint in 2023

name: AS/400 Order Management
description: Legacy order processing for French wholesale channel
notes: 150 orders/day still processed — SAP Cheddar will absorb this

name: Legacy HR System
description: On-premise HR and payroll (PeopleSoft)
notes: Being replaced by Workday — FR payroll still running here

name: Old Intranet
description: PHP-based company intranet
notes: Replaced by SharePoint Online — content migrated in 2024
